propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan-in LLM-backed project criteria into Pass 1 discovery despite project routing being described
Eval/CLI resolution is plan-review-biased and the code-review solver does not admit net-new project criterion prompts
Pass 3 routing does not consistently apply repository-effective threshold, posture, and nit-suppression values for project criteria

The project.review-phase-boundaries criterion must remain project-owned with advisory posture (blocking_enabled: false, block_threshold: 0.90) and enforce strict phase-ownership boundaries to prevent cross-phase directive drift
Integration seam repair must map logical project.<name> identifiers to validator-safe physical code-review-project-<name> identifiers without special-casing review-phase-boundaries
